title: HyperSignal results
description: What one run returns: the proxied tool's result, as a dataset item and as the OUTPUT record.

results.title: Signal results
results.description: Dataset with one item per run: { tool, summary, data, ts }, or { error } when the call failed.

output.title: OUTPUT record
output.description: The same { tool, summary, data } as a single JSON record in the key-value store.
